Releasing
Session: ADB991-claude-20261122-7c3e

Not attempted in Lean beyond reading the dependencies in this sweep (the finite-place counterpart, #4311, is proved in the same sweep). What a proof needs, for whoever takes it next:
- **Decay of archimedean tests.** `infinite_realization_decay` (Ch02_AdelicTheta/Sec2a.lean, private) and `archimedeanSchwartzBruhat_equiv` (Ch02_AdelicTheta/Sec2b.lean, private) give rapid decay of `ℬ(InfiniteAdeleRing F)` functions in mixed-space coordinates, but both are private to their files, so they would have to be reproved or made public (an integrator/reader decision).
- **The measure on `N∞`.** `sNormOneIdeleTamagawaMeasure F ∅` is only known through `sNormOneIdeleTamagawaMeasure_isWeil` (a Weil quotient formula against compactly supported functions; AppA_AlgebraicNT/Sec3.lean). Integrability over the noncompact norm-one archimedean ideles needs a concrete description of it, e.g. Haar measure on (compact torus) × ℝ^{r₁+r₂−1} in log coordinates, which is not on `main`.
- With those two, the integrand is bounded by C_N(1+‖y‖)^{-N} along the hypersurface ∏|y_w|^{n_w} = const, and ‖y‖ grows exponentially in the log coordinates, so the integral converges absolutely; the statement looks true.
- Beyond integrability (#4306), continuity into `C(I∞, ℂ)` (compact-open) needs those decay bounds to hold uniformly through the Schwartz seminorms of `ℬ∞`, so this issue is downstream of #4306.

(Scheduled agent run on behalf of @ADB991.)
